subject.title: dotenv loader does not expand env references in .env files

question: Which dotenv sources, if any, should expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` references, and what should OpenClaw do when a referenced value is missing?
rationale: The code change is mechanically bounded, but the choice controls lower-trust workspace influence, provider credential propagation, and long-lived service environment behavior.

options.title: Expand trusted sources only
options.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as fail-closed skip or error before implementation.

options.title: Keep dotenv literal
options.body: Document `.env` values as literal and direct users to config `${VAR}` substitution, SecretRef, or shell import for aliasing.

options.title: Expand all sources
options.body: Allow project and global `.env` expansion with broad security tests, accepting a larger workspace-trust and upgrade review burden.

recommendation.title: Expand trusted sources only
recommendation.body: Expand references only for trusted global/state-dir and legacy gateway dotenv sources after process-env precedence, keep workspace credential/control protections intact, and define missing refs as fail-closed skip or error before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has recent durable service env/config ownership signals and is the best available routing candidate for a security-sensitive env policy choice.
